releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 修复全局模式下路线模拟悬浮窗显示运行，但目标应用位置停留在路线起点的问题。
- 全局模式现在为所有目标应用共享同一个路线运行进度，并始终优先于遗留的单应用路线状态。
releaseNotes.en:
- Fixed an issue where the route overlay showed active playback in global mode while target apps remained at the route starting point.
- Global mode now shares one route runtime across all target apps and always takes priority over stale per-app route state.
